widgets.text: No tracked sessions yet. Open a game's Profile setup to enable automatic restoration. Launcher submission alone does not create a session.
Found 3 games from Steam, Heroic, Lutris, Legendary and custom entries. Missing or unreadable store records are skipped.
Manual restore is selected. Enable automatic restore after choosing Performance or Quiet and setting up the wrapper below.

Automatic restore uses Power Profiles Daemon and a dedicated systemd user scope. It needs an enabled, authorized daemon, a user systemd session and a supported kernel. A canceled hold is never automatically reapplied. Other profile holds can change the effective profile.
Set this as the game's wrapper in Legendary's configuration. It must wrap the actual game command; wrapping a Legendary launch request alone is not lifetime evidence.

Launcher/runtime compatibility still needs verification for your game. If setup cannot establish a profile hold, the wrapped command reports an error; switch to manual restore to run without this integration.
source: MOCK — fixture data, no real hardware
